annotations.title: Bank of Russia key rate: current level, since when, and recent changes

description:
Bank of Russia key rate: current level, since when, and recent changes. Current CBR key rate (% p.a.) from the cbr.ru DailyInfo web service (KeyRateXML; the hd_base/KeyRate page as fallback): rate, as_of, effective_since, previous_rate, last_change_bp and every change in the last `months` (default 24) newest first, plus min/max in the window. Cached 3 h.

GET /ru/key-rate — price $0.0015 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

months.description: History window in months for `changes` (default 24, max 120) Default: 24.
